info.title: API.SH: FindLaw
info.description: The FindLaw API from API.SH: public FindLaw data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Courts on FindLaw Caselaw. Without `jurisdiction`: the jurisdictions (`united-states` for the federal courts, then each state and territory). With one: its courts (`slug`, `name`, `url`), for use as `court` in `/findlaw/v1/recent-cases`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/findlaw-courts

parameters.name: jurisdiction
parameters.description: A jurisdiction slug, e.g. `california` or `united-states` (federal courts).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: courts of this jurisdiction: pass a slug as court to /findlaw/v1/recent-cases

Appellate Department Superior Court Lassen County California

get.description:
Law firms and attorneys in the FindLaw lawyer directory (lawyers.findlaw.com) for a legal issue and place, with every filter of the results page: rating, Super Lawyers, free consultation, virtual appointments, payment plans, credit cards, language and distance. `firms` and `attorneys` side by side as on the results page. Each: `name`, `url`, `id`, `type`, `placement` (`sponsored`, `spotlight`, `organic`), `rating` (out of 5, combined across review sites), `review_count`, `headline`, `address` (firms also `address_parts`, `latitude`, `longitude`), `additional_offices`, `firm` (an attorney's firm), practice `phone`, `website`, `years_experience`, `super_lawyers`, `attorney_ratings`, `free_consultation`, `achievements` and `image`. `total_firms` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/findlaw-lawyers

parameters.name: practice_area
parameters.description: Legal issue slug as on FindLaw, e.g. `divorce`, `criminal-law`, `immigration-naturalization-law` (see `/findlaw/v1/practice-areas`).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state: two-letter code (`WA`) or name.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of practice_area, state and city: a lawyers.findlaw.com/<legal-issue>/<state>/<city>/ link.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating: `1` to `5` (stars and up).

parameters.name: free_consultation
parameters.description: `true`: only those offering a free consultation.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/findlaw-profile

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
